LESSON: THE ANNUNCIATION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: The Annunciation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Annunciation
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: why sexual purity is important, • recite and meditate on Luke 1:37. Why is the birth of Jesus Christ unique?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. recite Luke 1:37 and trust in God’s power
2. retell the Birth of John the Baptist
3. discuss how John the Baptist prepared the way for the Messiah

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: recite Luke 1:37 and trust in God’s power

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: discuss how John the Baptist prepared the way for the Messiah

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: recite Luke 1:37 and trust in God’s power
• Model 2: retell the Birth of John the Baptist
• Model 3: discuss how John the Baptist prepared the way for the Messiah

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: recite Luke 1:37 and trust in God’s power
2. Practise: retell the Birth of John the Baptist
3. Practise: discuss how John the Baptist prepared the way for the Messiah

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Annunciation.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. why sexual purity is important, • recite and meditate on Luke 1:37. Why is the birth of Jesus Christ unique?
2. How is John the Baptist a precursor of Jesus Christ?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• recite Luke 1:37 and trust in God’s power
• retell the Birth of John the Baptist
• discuss how John the Baptist prepared the way for the Messiah

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
